title: Home Oxygen Therapy Field Evidence Standard: Last Use of Oxygen Before the Need Ended
content:
# Last Use Before the Need Ended — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Standard.** When Home Oxygen Therapy equipment is returned, the record closes on the day the need ended instead of the day of confirmation only when the most recent cylinder refill on the oxygen record, or the setup date when none is on record, falls on or before the day the need ended and no more than the window below before it. The window is the class's portable cylinder delivery cycle for a class with portable cylinder refills, the class's liquid reservoir refill cycle for a class with liquid refills, and 0 days for any other class. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the record closes on the day the return is confirmed.

## Window by system class

| System class | Kind of refills | Window (days before the day the need ended) |
|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | none | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | portable cylinders, every 14 days | 14 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | none | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | none | 0 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | liquid, every 7 days | 7 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | portable cylinders, every 14 days | 14 |

## The date measured

| Cylinder refill on the oxygen record | Date measured |
|---|---|
| at least one | the most recent cylinder refill |
| none | the setup date |

## Both sides (hypothetical, need ended 28 July)

| Window | Date measured | Gap | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 14 July | 14 days | met |
| 14 | 13 July | 15 days | fails |
| 14 | 30 July | after the day the need ended | fails |
| 7 | 21 July | 7 days | met |
| 7 | 20 July | 8 days | fails |
| 0 | 28 July | 0 days | met |
